title: The Maxx Crosby trade is a cannon shot signaling the start of a massive Raiders rebuild around Fernando Mendoza

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: The Maxx Crosby trade is a cannon shot signaling the start of a massive Raiders rebuild around Fernando Mendoza
sources.description: The eye-grabbing trade brought into focus the Ravens' all-in commitment and showcased that the Cowboys are serious about adding major pieces this offseason. None of it, however, was more meaningful than what the Raiders are setting up to do.
